cells.value: Foundation requirement • Every active agent, including Director • Planned intake; automatic collection and Cloudflare destination not yet proved.

Every Director/controller/worker mission emits structured outcomes and all applicable failure, blocker, correction and UNKNOWN records with trace/evidence pointers. Includes all active roles; future Sales before rollout.
Mission/run/task/parent IDs, agent ID + role, company/account scope, event ID, observed time and trace pointers. Successful outcomes supply mission totals; do not invent events that did not occur.
Map every active producer. Compare mission starts/completions with receipts; a silent or crashed agent creates a missing-report UNKNOWN, not an assumed success.
Capture expected versus actual behavior, category/stage, model/provider/tool, exact harness/runtime/rules/config versions, severity and trace/source pointers.
Record recovery attempts and outcome, human correction with source pointer, linked eval/experiment IDs, owner and next action. Preserve original observation and later resolutions.
A real Director or tool failure has a complete, redacted record and trace read-back. Missing facts stay UNKNOWN; no secrets or copied unrestricted customer content.
Separate blockers from failures: permission, credential, required approval, uncertain identity, unavailable tool, API limit or dependency.
Record affected step, reason, owner, dependency, exact resume condition and clearance evidence. A normal approval boundary is not automatically an agent error.
An approval/permission block remains parked without bypass; independent work can proceed. A needless escalation can be investigated as a separate failure.
Separate event kind, outcome/evidence certainty and resolution state. Failure: OPEN / FIXED / WONT_FIX; blocker: OPEN / CLEARED. UNKNOWN never means PASS.

Stable event IDs deduplicate delivery; group repeated errors by signature and versions, retaining count, first/last time and evidence pointers. Record short recovered incidents without a full investigation.
Replay the same receipt without another event; do not collapse distinct missions. FIXED or CLEARED needs read-back evidence; original failure remains in history.
One Observatory intake; failure/blocker ledgers are views of one authoritative operational store, linked to existing eval and experiment history.
Inventory and name the existing store, raw-file destination, writer route and access scope. Cloudflare service/bucket/database selection remains unverified; no new database by default.
Collector outage: retain a bounded local pending receipt, show delivery UNKNOWN, then drain once without duplicates. Independent reconciliation detects absent terminal reports.
Confirmed recurring OR high-impact failures become deduplicated eval candidates with expected behavior, source, version and relevance.
Review/freeze the expected result before active promotion. Link failure → eval → experiment → verified fix; keep regressions versioned, with an explicit reason for retirement.
Original failure + relevant regressions pass; unchanged protected holdout stays hidden. Permission-denial tests reward the correct stop. No self-weakened grader or automatic production release.
Raw operational events and traces stay in the authoritative store. Prime/AI Search receives distilled, source-backed findings with evidence pointers.
A promoted lesson names the cause, applicable versions, tested fix, experiment, limits and measured result. Unproven hypotheses remain labeled. Existing tenant/access scope follows retrieval.
A fresh agent retrieves the original failure and proven lesson through their proper routes. Raw error floods are not copied into vector knowledge.
Return open failures/blockers, corrections, UNKNOWNs, proven/rejected fixes, current baseline and queue; show clusters over a specified mission window.
Include source freshness, producer coverage, missing reports, per-category counts and mission totals. Distinguish a closed blocker from a fixed bug and a suggested fix from a proven one.
Fresh controller answers where a task failed without Alex retelling. Counts reconcile to stored events; uncovered agents are visible rather than silently omitted.
Prove real failure capture now, while Director already runs work. Collector is a prerequisite for Sales shadow/rollout; future roles pass the same contract test.
One real failure, one legitimate blocker, one Alex correction and one UNKNOWN; repeat delivery and collector interruption; read back from a fresh agent. All active producers accounted for.
Prove linked eval/experiment/fix and distilled lesson for one confirmed case. Until these receipts exist, automatic capture remains To do. No historical example counts are claimed.
SOURCE • Alex’s shared failure-history proposal, Oct 5, 2026. This tab specifies the intake contract; it is not a live failure ledger or a new operational store.
